pathways.pathway: Gemini video understanding on Google AI Studio Free tier
reasons: The spec forbids any Gemini call until the Google AI Studio PROJECT (not the key/model) is verified on the Free billing tier and the exact model/operation is available without billing. That is a console-side fact (AI Studio project billing page) this session cannot observe; no check was possible, so no call was made.

No provider-neutral Gemini video-understanding adapter exists in the repo (only providers/runtime/adapters/cloud-google-veo.js for generation and lib/research-deep/provider-interface.js for research). Building one is new provider work outside this closure and could not be exercised without the tier proof.
Free-tier privacy: uploading the file to the Free tier needs separate authorization; the pilot content is the project's own test/fixture media, but that authorization was not given in this session.
No GEMINI/GOOGLE API key is present in this session's process environment; the repo .env was deliberately not read.
pathways.unblockBy: Owner confirms in AI Studio that the project is on the Free tier and the configured model supports video input without billing, authorizes the upload, and approves adding a video-review adapter (new code) or supplies the existing one.

pathways.pathway: Local multimodal reviewer over the actual video + audio
reasons: No local audio+video model stack is installed or wired; the spec says no new heavyweight model stack is required in this pass.

pathways.pathway: Genuine operator full watch of the actual file
reasons: Requires a human to actually watch and listen; the agent cannot perform or attest it and has not auto-filled any checklist.

sessionAgentFrameReview.note: The earlier 5-frame session review remains visual-only and partial; it is not a full audiovisual watch and is not counted.

note: Preconditions only (audio stream present, level measured by ffmpeg volumedetect). They do not constitute a watch.
